description: Seed benchmark for conservative cross-site air-fryer recipe deduplication. Expand with adjudicated real-world pairs as the corpus grows.

left.title: Air Fryer Chicken Breast
instructions: Coat chicken with oil and seasoning.
Air fry at 375 F until cooked through.

right.title: Crispy Air Fryer Chicken Breasts
instructions: Coat the chicken breasts in olive oil and seasonings.
Cook in the air fryer at 375 degrees until done.

left.title: Air Fryer Salmon
instructions: Brush salmon with oil and season.
Air fry until flaky.

right.title: Easy Air Fryer Salmon Recipe
instructions: Brush the salmon fillets with oil and seasoning.
Cook in the air fryer until the salmon flakes easily.

left.title: Air Fryer Baked Potato
instructions: Rub potatoes with oil and salt.
Air fry until tender and crisp.

right.title: Best Air Fryer Baked Potatoes
instructions: Coat each potato with olive oil and salt.
Cook in the air fryer until crisp outside and tender inside.

left.title: Air Fryer Chicken Wings
instructions: Dry wings and toss with seasonings.
Air fry, turning once, until crisp.

right.title: Crispy Air Fryer Chicken Wings
instructions: Pat the wings dry and coat with baking powder and seasoning.
Air fry and flip once until crispy.

left.title: Air Fryer Green Beans
instructions: Toss green beans with oil and seasoning.
Air fry until blistered and tender.

right.title: Easy Air Fryer Green Beans
instructions: Toss the beans in olive oil and seasonings.
Cook in the air fryer until tender with browned spots.

left.title: Air Fryer Pork Chops
instructions: Oil and season pork chops.
Air fry, flipping halfway, until done.

right.title: Easy Air Fryer Pork Chop Recipe
instructions: Coat pork chops with oil and spices.
Cook in the air fryer and turn halfway through.

left.title: Air Fryer French Fries
instructions: Cut potatoes into fries and soak.
Dry, oil, and air fry until golden.

right.title: Homemade Air Fryer French Fries
instructions: Slice the potatoes into fries and soak them.
Dry well, toss with oil, and air fry until crisp and golden.

left.title: Air Fryer Broccoli
instructions: Toss broccoli with oil and seasoning.
Air fry until browned at the edges.

right.title: Crispy Air Fryer Broccoli
instructions: Coat the broccoli in oil and spices.
Cook in the air fryer until the edges are crisp.

left.title: Air Fryer Shrimp
instructions: Season shrimp with oil and spices.
Air fry just until opaque.

right.title: Quick Air Fryer Shrimp Recipe
instructions: Toss shrimp with olive oil and seasonings.
Cook in the air fryer until opaque and curled.

left.title: Air Fryer Asparagus
instructions: Toss asparagus with oil, salt, and pepper.
Air fry until crisp tender.

right.title: Easy Air Fryer Asparagus
instructions: Coat asparagus in oil and seasonings.
Cook in the air fryer until crisp-tender.

left.title: Air Fryer Meatballs
instructions: Mix ingredients and form meatballs.
Air fry until browned and cooked through.

right.title: Easy Air Fryer Meatball Recipe
instructions: Combine ingredients and shape into meatballs.
Cook in the air fryer until browned and done inside.

left.title: Air Fryer Cauliflower
instructions: Season cauliflower with oil and spices.
Air fry until browned and tender.

right.title: Crispy Air Fryer Cauliflower
instructions: Toss cauliflower in olive oil and spices.
Cook in the air fryer until crisp at the edges and tender.
